_about: Where each product keeps Hawkes Gen's JS SDK. Products keep copies (their own CI and site builds can't read this private repo), and `node bin/hawkesgen-sdk.mjs sync` writes the current files into every one; `status` lists the ones behind. Paths are folders in each repo (next to C:\Projects\hawkesgen, /srv/hawkes on the server). Add a product here when it starts using the SDK. The analytics SDK (hawkes-analytics.js, .mjs and their .d.ts) is also served at https://gen.hawkesgen.com/sdk/analytics@1.js for pages that load it from Gen. Hawkes Net (hawkes-net.mjs with hawkes-net-core.mjs next to it, docs/net.md) is served at /sdk/hawkes-net.mjs the same way.
